name: Create: Wizardry
description: Create: Wizardry makes mana a Create fluid.

pages.title: Create: Wizardry
pages.text: **Create: Wizardry** makes [#](7A3C9A)[mana](entry://glossary/mana)[#]() a Create fluid. It needs Iron's Spells, and adds machines to extract, pipe and use mana. Pipe it like water, but mind the leaks.

pages.title: Mana Siphon
pages.text: Draws mana from players, spells and mobs. Placed above it, a crystalline block can crystallize mana into Arcane Essence. Drained arcane ingots never turn into netherite here.

pages.title: Arcane Pipe
pages.text:
Carries mana.\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** un-insulated pipes rapidly leak it. Insulate with Arcane Sheets.

pages.title: Arcane Pump
pages.text: Made from an Arcane Pipe and a cogwheel. Moves mana by rotation, like a Mechanical Pump.

pages.title: Arcane Casing
pages.text: The [#](7A3C9A)[casing](entry://glossary/encased)[#]() for the mod's machines. See Casings in the Create entries.

pages.title: Channeler
pages.text: Harvests Liquid Lightning from lightning bolts. Takes a Bottle of Lightning from Iron's Spells.

pages.title: Blaze Caster
pages.text: A contraption that casts scroll spells. Must be [#](7A3C9A)[superheated](entry://glossary/superheated)[#](). Works in Impulse or Sentry modes.
The Blaze Caster holds a scroll and casts it using mana. Not every spell is compatible with it. Heat is Create's: see [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() and a blaze burner.

Other fluids: Liquid Lightning, Blood (from compressing meat or boiling mobs), Fire Ale and Netherward Tincture.\
\
Several are made by Create [#](2E5AAC)[processing](entry://create_basics/processing)[#]() such as [#](7A3C9A)[mixing](entry://glossary/mixing)[#](); look recipes up in [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#](). Back to [#](2E5AAC)[Magic](entry://exploration/magic)[#]().
